notes.title: Update
notes.notes: Added a function to set the data start date, now allowing the selection of the start date. If a random start date is desired, it can be disabled on the game's confirmation screen upon entering

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Optimize the initial data of the real data training script. Now the initial data of the daily line has increased from 50 to 150. And the data is real.

The initial amount of money for players has been increased to 1,000,000.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Adding historical list records will record the top ten transactions with the highest returns
The entrance is the best in the history of information

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Slightly elevate the frequency of simulated trades.
The foundational functionality for recording liquidations has been refined. Now, upon a player's initial liquidation, the liquidation interface will prompt automatically. Additionally, the message notification icon will appear with each liquidation.

notes.title: Urgent update
notes.notes:
I have added impulse trading to single-day trading, simulating the power to influence market trends. Now, the single-day trends are more difficult to predict and wilder. Additionally, I have updated the mail feature, removing the original function and adding a feature to preview clearing stocks.

I must admit that this part is a semi-finished product, because my original plan was to complete this part first, then modify the single-day trading. However, today many players have provided feedback that single-day trading is disappointing, so I prioritized resolving the single-day trading issue. As a result, the original function of the mail feature has been removed and only a semi-finished product has been released. Nonetheless, it is only one step away from completion and will be finished soon.

Since the new feature is relatively urgent, please let me know if there are any problems.

notes.title: Game Release Announcement
notes.notes: I plan to release an Early Access version first because I want to continue optimizing the game before the official release. The release date may be delayed because the store interface failed re-audit. Therefore, I need to modify the image assets of the store interface, then submit for review, and wait for Steamworks to approve.

notes.title: The demo version will launch on May 15th.
notes.notes:
The planned demo version will be launched on May 15th.
